title: Thrust Reverser Blocker Door Link — Removal

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of the blocker door links from a reverser half with the lockout and deactivation that must be in place first, and the bushing measurement that is recorded before the link leaves the cowl.

sections.purpose: This task removes the blocker door links from one reverser half so that the links, their bushings or the aft seal can be examined or replaced.
sections.job_setup_note: The reverser must be deactivated and the lockout fitted before any person puts a hand inside the cowl. A reverser that deploys with someone inside will not be survivable. The bushing measurement is taken with the link still in place, because the reading changes once the link is off its pin and no longer under load.
sections.procedure: 1. Confirm that the engine has been shut down for at least one hour and that the aircraft is not on the auxiliary power unit. 2. Deactivate the thrust reverser in accordance with the maintenance manual and fit the lockout. Record the lockout serial number. WARNING: DO NOT PUT A HAND OR A TOOL INSIDE THE COWL UNTIL THE REVERSER IS DEACTIVATED AND THE LOCKOUT IS FITTED AND RECORDED. 3. Open the reverser half and support it on the strut. 4. Photograph each blocker door link in position before anything is disturbed. 5. Measure each bushing bore at two planes ninety degrees apart with the bore gauge, with the link still on its pin, and record both readings. 6. Examine the aft seal D7830117902757 at each link position for lip damage, hardening and debris tracking, and record what you find. 7. Release the retention on the clevis pin EN768314K5 at the first link. 8. Withdraw the pin and support the link. CAUTION: THE BLOCKER DOOR WILL DROP WHEN THE LAST LINK IS RELEASED. SUPPORT THE DOOR BEFORE THE FINAL PIN IS WITHDRAWN. 9. Remove the link and put it in a bag marked with the link position. 10. Repeat for the remaining links. 11. Examine the link housing bore for pick-up and for signs that the bushing has been turning in the housing. 12. Check the nozzle 9ET and the seal 6577ET while access is available. 13. Check the mount link 83ET for fretting at its attachment.
sections.close_out: Keep the photographs, the bushing measurements and the seal condition record with the work pack; they feed the fleet wear model. Do not remove the lockout at the end of this task; it stays fitted until the installation task is complete and tested.

type_data.effectivity_note: SOLANO-30 and SOLANO-34 aircraft; the bushing limits differ between the delivered and the self-lubricating standard

safety_precautions: Deactivate the reverser and fit the lockout before entry.
Support the blocker door before the final pin is withdrawn.
Support the reverser half on the strut.
